subject: The 2AM scan that saved Sarah
preview_text: 800 users scanned today. Sarah caught gaslighting before her lease was up. See what they found.
body_paragraphs: Yesterday, 843 people opened Red Flag Scanner AI and ran a scan. One of them was Sarah. She'd been ignoring that knot in her stomach for weeks, telling herself she was overthinking. Then she screenshot a 2AM text conversation, hit scan, and the app flagged a pattern of gaslighting she'd missed entirely. Her lease was up in 30 days. She got out.

Here's the part that stings: most users tell us they wish they'd scanned earlier. The first scan feels like admitting something's wrong. But once you see the data — the toxicity score, the flagged phrases, the pattern breakdown — you realize your gut was right all along. And you're not alone. 800+ people have used this to break cycles. They're not special. They just hit scan.

You already have the app. The hard part is done. Open it, pull up any conversation that's been nagging at you — even a short one — and let the AI show you what's really happening. The pattern detection across messages is what catches the subtle stuff. The stuff your brain wants to rationalize away.

Open Red Flag Scanner AI and scan a conversation you've been unsure about. Just one. See what the data says. P.S. Most users say the first scan is the hardest. After that, it becomes a reflex. You've got this.
